messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: INCIDENT P1 - Elevated tail latency for /v1/stream (eu-west-1). p95 jumped from ~420ms to ~1.8s; p99 from ~1.2s to ~6.5s. Streaming stalls observed (client-side reads blocked). Spike start ~12:15 UTC. Cache prefix hitrate dropped from 88% -> 12% around the same time. Tagging oncall.
Maya (oncall): I'm oncall, joining now. Logged into dashboards.
Ava K: grabbing logs and top traces, looking at routing and cache metrics
Jared M: I see a deploy event at 12:14 UTC to prefix-mapping service (deploy id: dpl-2026-04-12-11). It was a partial rollout to eu-west (30%).
Tanvi S: that was my prefix-delta change (algorithm tweak + new salt). I rolled it behind a flag at 12:10 and ramped to 30% at 12:14. Could be correlated.
Samir R: storage/caching team here. KV read miss rate for prefix-cache spiked at exactly 12:15. Logs show mismatch between in-flight request prefix and stored key hash. Example log snippet:
```
2026-04-12T12:15:23Z ERROR cache_miss key="prefix:usr:8a3f.." expected_hash=0x5a3f got_hash=0x0
2026-04-12T12:15:23Z WARN stream stall request_id=rid-9f8b client=app-frontend-21 stall_ms=4200
```
Samir R: running quick query for prefix cache hitrate:
```
SELECT time_bucket('1m', ts) AS minute, avg(hit) as hit_rate FROM metrics.cache_prefix WHERE region='eu-west-1' AND ts > now() - interval '30 minutes' GROUP BY minute ORDER BY minute DESC LIMIT 10;
-- result: last 4 points: 0.12, 0.10, 0.11, 0.09
```
Ava K: customer impact? which tenants in eu-west hit the stalls
Priya C - CS: Customer A (enterprise-search) reported degraded streaming via support at 12:30, Customer D (chatbot pipeline) seeing reconnects. Not a full failure but sessions stall for seconds.
Jared M: deploy-bot shows rollout details:
```
deploy-bot: deploy dpl-2026-04-12-11 prefix-mapping-service -> eu-west-1, rollout=30%, author=tanvi
```
Maya (oncall): immediate mitigation options? revert rollout, enable fallback to legacy hash, or run invalidation + warmup. Prioritize lowest-risk fast path.
Ava K: revert to previous mapping or enable compatibility mode that accepts both hashes on lookup. Revert should be quick via deployment rollback to previous config.
Tanvi S: I can flip the feature flag back to legacy immediately. Doing that now.
Tanvi S: FLAG:prefix-delta -> OFF (12:21 UTC)
Ava K: monitoring... cache hitrate starting to recover slightly to ~45% at 12:25 but still noisy
Samir R: initiating targeted cache invalidation for keys created after 12:10 to force coherent rebuild. Command:
```
$ tools/cachectl invalidate --region eu-west-1 --prefix 'prefix:' --since '2026-04-12T12:10:00Z'
```
Samir R: running warmup job to refill hot prefixes using historical traffic samples (bulk_preload job)
deploy-bot: job bulk_preload started (job-id: bp-4521) at 12:28 UTC
Ava K: also throttling burst routing for eu-west for next 20m to reduce tail amplification
Maya (oncall): any fallback plan if revert fails? Route traffic to us-east as temporary mitigation? That adds latency for EU but keeps service stable.
Jared M: We can shift non-sensitive traffic to us-east via routing policy change (policy id: route-fallback-7). I'll prepare the policy but hold until we see revert effect.
Priya C - CS: please paste a short customer-facing note I can send to affected customers. They want ETA and action list.
Ava K: cs note: "We're actively mitigating an issue causing brief streaming stalls in eu-west. Engineers reverted a recent prefix mapping change; cache refills and warmup jobs are running. Expect progressive improvement over next 30–45 minutes. We'll follow up with a full incident report." (sendable)
Samir R: cache hitrate at 12:33 -> 68%, stalls dropping; p95 now ~650ms, p99 ~1.9s. Progressing.
Tanvi S: confirmed feature flag fully off and old mapping restored at 12:31. I also pushed a compatibility guard to accept both hashes on read for a short period.
Ava K: logs show decreasing stream stall counts. Starting to mark incident as mitigated at 12:40 UTC if metrics hold.
incident-bot: INCIDENT UPDATE - Mitigation in place. p95 trending down to ~480ms, p99 ~1.3s. Continue monitoring for 1h.
Maya (oncall): handing off to Jared for post-incident follow-up and RCA. I'm going to sleep but will be reachable if needed. :zzz:
Jared M: taking handoff. I'll own the RCA, backlog tasks, and follow-up runbook updates. Notes so far: root cause likely incompatibility between new prefix hashing salt and existing persisted cache keys leading to a high miss storm and downstream tail amplification in streaming code paths.
Jared M: immediate action items for follow-up:
- confirm exact set of persisted keys that became inaccessible
- bake an acceptance test to detect prefix-hash drift in rollout jobs
- add a gradual ramp checker (metric spike guard) to rollback rollouts when cache miss delta > 20%
- update runbook with explicit steps for graceful compatibility toggles
Samir R: leaving a sticky note on storage: consider versioned cache keys (v2 tag) to avoid silent incompatibility in future rollouts
Priya C - CS: I'll send the customer note and open a single-threaded update channel for affected customers.
Jared M: creating postmortem doc and will ping team to contribute. For now, marking thread for incident-postmortem. Thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
Maya (oncall): final handoff note: monitor p99 <= 1.5s for 45m, if it creeps re-route to us-east and escalate to infra lead.
Jared M: ack. I'll keep updates in this thread and ship the postmortem link when ready.
